reason: H0 invokes the changed frame-decoding API with the obsolete pixel-origin arguments and provides no decode-frame-options argument. Against S1, this call is incompatible, so the harness cannot exercise the GIF frame-decoding entry point.
evidence: S1 removes a_pixbuf_origin_x and a_pixbuf_origin_y from wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_frame and adds wuffs_base__decode_frame_options* a_opts after a_work_buffer.
S1 introduces the new public type wuffs_base__decode_frame_options.
The changed decoder.decode_frame body marks args.opts as TODO and does not yet dereference it, but the new argument remains part of the required API protocol.
recommended_action: Update H0 to use the S1 signature, removing the two origin arguments and passing a valid options mode such as NULL; optionally also exercise a zero-initialized wuffs_base__decode_frame_options value so both nullable and non-null API forms remain fuzzed as option semantics are implemented.
